import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a count plot of survival rate by passenger class
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=titanic, x='pclass', hue='survived', palette='coolwarm')
plt.title('Survival Count by Passenger Class')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1, 2], labels=['1st', '2nd', '3rd'])

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
